rationale: Extend the existing governed publication-decision and authoritative-publication capabilities with generic data-driven builders for governed assertion publication, while repairing the generic conditional co-payment certification runner to preserve its known governed binding-manifest path as an explicit certification trace. Bajaj My Health Care v2 is supplied only through a governed publication specification; no Bajaj-specific publication Python remains. The generic builders resolve only declared publication-state boundaries and carry certified component semantics into the structured publication contract without adding reasoning rules or product-level co-payment authority.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded or replaced. Existing Star publication modules remain as legacy bounded callers and can be migrated separately; new equivalent co-payment publication onboarding does not require a product-specific publication module.
authority_impact: No new insurance, recommendation, policy-instance, option-selection, or claim-payment authority is introduced. Publication remains bounded to one certified assertion and retains the certification limitation prohibiting policy-specific option selection and claim-payment decisions. The certification repair adds lineage completeness only; the data-driven publication extension changes orchestration shape, not authority.
